scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索)：面向帖子、问答、评论的语义匹配、查询理解、短文本召回和排序；核心指标为 nDCG 和 CTR。

papers.title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
papers.abstract: Deployment-aligned QAD framework supports NVFP4 MXFP4 Q4_K, 8B–230B models; Qwen3.5-9B 68.9% NVFP4 versus PTQ 65.4%, MXFP4 66.0% versus 56.4%.
papers.authors: Weili Xu, Jisen Li, Yuqing Jian, Chenxi Li, Zhizhou Sha, Yifan Yu, Qingyang Wu, Chenfeng Xu, Zhongzhu Zhou, Tianyi Zhang, Ben Athiwaratkun
papers.summary: QATFactory 针对低精度部署损失质量的问题，把部署时的量化噪声纳入蒸馏和强化学习训练，并以 BF16 执行矩阵运算。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，NVFP4 平均准确率为 68.9%，高于 PTQ 的 65.4%；MXFP4 为 66.0%，高于 56.4%，支持直接导出到 vLLM 和 llama.cpp。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索中的查询理解与语义重排模型可先尝试部署格式一致的量化蒸馏，再同时评估 nDCG、CTR 和服务延迟。不同 FP4 格式需要不同的训练量化策略，不能把一个配置直接复制到所有硬件；本文准确率来自通用基准，业务收益仍需独立验证。
papers.scoring_reason: 量化训练、蒸馏与部署格式对齐，直接支持社区搜索模型降本。

papers.title: Mitigating the Length-Scaling Tax with Online Distillation
papers.authors: Xu Wan, Wenyue Xu, Shengjie Zhao, Mingyang Sun
papers.abstract: Length scaling during reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training is often viewed as a sign of improved reasoning ability, especially on difficult problems, but may also make responses to already-solved problems unnecessarily verbose. We quantify this side effect as the length-scaling tax (LST): excess response length on already-solved queries without a commensurate accuracy gain. To mitigate LST, we propose Length Self-Distillation (LSD), which routes solved prompts to on-policy distillation and retains the original RL objective for unsolved prompts. LSD uses an exponential moving average of the online policy as its teacher, requiring no external model. We find that LSD achieves comparable or better performance than RL across multiple variants, while substantially curbing response-length growth on easy queries. LSD reduces LST from 19.0% to -3.7% on single-turn reasoning and from 31.4% to 13.7% on multi-turn agentic tasks, demonstrating that LSD effectively preserves concise response pa
papers.summary: 论文将已解答问题上的无效输出增长定义为长度扩展税，并提出长度自蒸馏 LSD。方法把已解决提示路由到在线蒸馏，未解决提示继续使用强化学习，以当前策略的指数移动平均作为教师；单轮推理的长度税由 19.0% 降至 −3.7%，多轮任务由 31.4% 降至 13.7%，保持相近或更好的任务表现。
papers.key_insight: 训练时按问题是否已解决分配不同目标，可以避免简单查询为难题探索付出不必要的解码成本。社区 UGC 搜索可在查询改写或理解模型上实验这种路由，并结合结果质量、输出长度及尾延迟评估；论文的长度税不是直接的端到端延迟指标，不能等同为线上加速幅度。
papers.scoring_reason: 训练目标控制解码成本，适合搜索查询理解服务。

papers.title: Build Local AI Apps with C++ and NVIDIA TensorRT RTX Samples
papers.abstract: Adding AI models to local applications requires a portable model format, a reliable runtime, and acceleration that works across target systems. Do Inference Now...
papers.summary: NVIDIA 的 DIN Deploy 以 ONNX 导出器连接原生 C++ 应用，使用 ONNX Runtime 与 TensorRT RTX 加速 Windows、Linux 本地推理。DGX Spark 上 Parakeet TDT 达到实时速度的 206.41 倍，CPU 为 14.44 倍；SAM 2.1 GPU 达到 38.3 FPS，CPU 为 0.5 FPS，量化模型可作为接口不变的替换件。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴模型导出与应用运行时解耦，把社区多媒体内容处理接入统一的 C++ 推理接口，减少每种模型分别实现运行时的维护成本。文章中的语音和分割数据不能作为文本排序加速依据；迁移到社区搜索前，应验证 ONNX 算子覆盖、量化后的相关性及目标硬件表现。
papers.scoring_reason: 公开部署样例与真实硬件测试，满足工业实践覆盖。

papers.title: TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Jiangnan Yu, Ceyu Xu, Mengming Li, Shiyu Huang, Yiran Xia, Jian Weng, Hui Xue, Haohui Mai, Yuan Xie
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.38201v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated.
  We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Termi
papers.summary: TomasuLLM 针对编译和测试造成的工具等待，借鉴乱序处理器设计提前执行预测动作。系统以写时复制沙箱隔离推测操作，追踪依赖与副作用，再按轨迹顺序验证提交；在 100 个 SWE-bench 任务上加速 1.31 倍，在 28 个 Terminal-Bench 任务上加速 1.35 倍，4010 条提交验证记录中未出现误接受。
papers.key_insight: 运行时创新在于把提前执行与结果可见性分开，让并发任务在验证后才影响正式状态。社区搜索的离线索引构建和评测工具链可借鉴隔离、依赖追踪与顺序提交，但这不是在线召回加速的直接证据；应先在有明确副作用边界的工程任务中验证。
papers.scoring_reason: 核心是工具执行运行时与正确性保障，归入系统基建。

papers.title: From Inference Engine to Inference Control Plane: Connecting vLLM, llm-d, and the Evolution of Efficient Distributed LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Connects engine optimization and control-plane routing scheduling cache management; survey of research implementations and production studies.
papers.summary: 文章梳理 LLM 服务从单副本执行优化走向缓存、请求路由和容量协调的过程，并提出推理执行规划器。它把 vLLM 与 llm-d 分为引擎与控制平面，引用原始 vLLM 研究的 2–4 倍吞吐结果；作者明确这是一篇系统综述，没有新增性能测量，引用结果来自不同硬件和工作负载。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索部署多个查询理解或重排副本时，应联合考虑队列、KV 缓存命中、状态传输和服务目标，而不是只选一个快速引擎。可先在现有 serving 上增加可观测性，再验证缓存感知路由；文中不同系统的倍数不能相加、平均或当成统一基准结果。
papers.scoring_reason: 服务引擎与控制平面架构综述，数字明确归属原始研究。

papers.title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
papers.authors: Jenna Russell, Ben Glickenhaus, Katherine Thai, John Wieting, Mohit Iyyer
papers.abstract: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. S
papers.summary: 论文研究自然网页中未经专门筛选的 AI 文本对语言模型预训练的影响。FineWeb 过滤后，2026 年 6 月与 8 月数据分别有 27.5% 和 31.1% 的 token 被检测为 AI 生成；作者训练 800 个模型并拟合损失扩展规律，发现低人类数据预算下收益先增后减，高预算下加入 AI 文本很快产生负作用。
papers.key_insight: 数据平台不能只按 token 数量规划扩容，还应追踪来源、人类文本预算和混入比例。社区 UGC 语料尤其需要把自然产生的 AI 帖子与受控合成样本区分，对查询理解模型进行分层验证；文中的检测器标签存在误差，800 个模型的结果也不代表所有规模与任务。
papers.scoring_reason: 预训练数据成本与质量管理，迁移到社区领域训练。

papers.title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior
papers.authors: Atsuki Yamaguchi, Tatsuro Inaba, Joel Niklaus, Michal Štefánik, Aline Villavicencio
papers.abstract: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mixtures that combine diverse sources (e.g., code and math). We therefore present a comprehensive study on PPT spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four parameter scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens. Our results demonstrate that the downstream performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale, e.g., saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale. However, in contrast to prior work, we find no consistent evidence that these gains stem from a grammatical pr
papers.summary: 研究检验合成非自然语言预预训练能否在更大模型和真实数据混合下保持价值。实验覆盖 5 类预训练任务、4 种数据混合、500M 至 7B 的 4 个模型规模及最多 100B token；3B 模型至少节省 21B 正式预训练 token，但没有一致证据支持这些收益源自语法先验。
papers.key_insight: 训练平台应将可复现的成本收益与解释性假说分开，避免把语法先验当成已验证机制。社区搜索若计划训练领域语言模型，可将预预训练作为小规模对照实验，最终按 nDCG、CTR 和总训练预算取舍；已有成熟模型的微调场景不能直接套用这里的节省量。
papers.scoring_reason: 训练 token 效率研究，属于模型训练技术与成本规划。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Yanbei Chen, Anirudh Goyal, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi
papers.abstract: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. Yet existing scaling laws model recurrence or sparsity in isolation. In this work, we introduce Loop Scaling Laws, the first scaling law to jointly model recurrence and sparsity alongside model size and data. At its core is a bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping that characterizes the effective-parameter gain from looping and how sparsity raises this gain. The laws predict the held-out loss of looped models more accurately than prior alternatives, and recover the standard dense and MoE scaling laws as special cases. Beyond prediction, the fitted laws provide a principled foundation for designing looped MoE models under compute and memory constraints. Downstream evaluations further demonstrate the complementary benefits of the two axes: sparsity delive
papers.summary: 论文联合建模循环 Transformer 与混合专家的扩展规律，以依赖稀疏度的有界循环映射描述有效参数增益。下游评测显示，稀疏机制带来约 3 倍活跃参数效率，循环机制在推理任务上带来约 2 倍总参数效率；在万亿 token 级别及相同训练计算预算下，循环 MoE 可匹配约 2 倍规模的非循环模型。
papers.key_insight: 平台预算应分别核算总参数、活跃参数与循环次数，不能仅按模型文件大小判断成本。社区搜索的自建查询理解模型可据此探索内存受限的训练方案，但增加循环也可能增加推理串行路径；论文报告的是推理基准效率，不是社区搜索 nDCG 或线上吞吐提升。
papers.scoring_reason: 循环与稀疏模型的计算内存约束设计。

papers.title: The Evolution of Attention in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Emerging Trends
papers.authors: Zhentao Tan, Jingyi Shen, Yanbo Li, Yao Liu, Yue Wu
papers.abstract:
Self-attention gives LLMs fine-grained, query-dependent access to context, but dense token interactions incur quadratic prefill cost and a key--value cache growing with context length. Research thus spans explicit-memory compression, sparse access, recurrent state construction, structured state dynamics, and heterogeneous mechanism composition. This survey analyzes these developments as model-internal contextual memory. We introduce a five-dimensional lens---Memory Representation, Memory Update, Access, Readout, and Integration---describing what is represented, how it changes, what is query-eligible, how it is read, and how readouts form outputs. This lens compares overlapping research lines without imposing one computational model.
  We reconstruct mechanism-level developments and architectural adoption using 59 release-level records from 14 major model lineages and 11 high-performing open-weight endpoints. First, explicit-memory and recurrent-state methods retain distinct interfaces
papers.summary: 综述把注意力演进统一为模型内部上下文内存设计，从表示、更新、访问、读出和融合 5 个维度比较压缩、稀疏、循环及混合机制。作者整理 14 个主要模型谱系的 59 条发布记录与 11 个开放权重端点，分析预填充计算和 KV 缓存的权衡；这些数字是调研范围，并非新系统的加速实验。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的查询理解服务需要按上下文长度、缓存容量和访问方式选择架构，而不能只比较模型参数量。该综述提供统一的选型语言，可用于组织长文本重排和批量推理实验；具体 nDCG、尾延迟和显存收益必须在目标模型上测量，文章不提供可直接外推的统一性能结论。
papers.scoring_reason: 注意力与上下文内存架构综述，为 serving 选型提供参考。

papers.title: Project Tapestry: Milestone Zero
papers.abstract: Federated continued pretraining of OLMo 3 7B on 12 billion tokens, four sites across India Australia USA, exchanging weights only. Three models trained or tuned. Milestone zero completed September 1 2026; does not demonstrate frontier model superiority.
papers.summary: Project Tapestry 展示数据留在本地、仅交换模型权重的跨地域联合训练平台。9 月 1 日完成的零号里程碑覆盖印度、澳大利亚和美国的 4 个站点，训练或调优 3 个模型；其中 OLMo 3 7B 完成 12B token 的继续预训练，没有把原始训练数据移出站点，项目仍处于平台推进阶段。
papers.key_insight: 对于不同社区或地区的数据不能集中存放的场景，可以探索本地更新、中心整合的训练架构。其核心实践启示是将数据控制权和模型共享路径分别设计；权重交换并不自动消除隐私风险，项目也未证明搜索指标或前沿模型能力更强，应先测量通信成本与业务质量。
papers.scoring_reason: 社区 UGC 的跨地区数据控制与联合训练有直接平台关联；需适配且平台仍在推进，实用性 3。
